points.why: Signs all four links correctly, counts two minus signs to show the loop is reinforcing, and says the lead's response is what feeds the spiral.
Identifies the balancing loop through more labeled data and says which loop dominates depends on the labeling team's capacity.
Never says the reinforcing loop can run upward into a virtuous cycle; it treats it only as a downward spiral past capacity.
Recommends capping inflow to capacity, targeting examples via active learning, and tracking label quality directly with a gold set or agreement measure.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects 'we always respond to drops' as proof of self-correction.
